scope: deterministic only until gate; two development cases; no held-out inference

inherited_options.base_model: posterior physics mean + sequential stationary ST
inherited_options.current_observation_protocol: fixed-stride unsaturated plus every observed-censored pixel
inherited_options.calibration_target: known reference-camera measurement in deliberately hidden band
inherited_options.models: {"A": "Current-only ambient mean + RBF", "B": "Posterior physics mean + RBF", "C": "Posterior physics mean + sequential stationary ST"}

effective_evaluation: native physical-area weights; exact 1% with fractional last node
metadata_caveat: Inherited top-25/grid and calibration-target CSV labels are historical; not executed here.
refinement_scope: source contribution only; predecessor contribution held at frozen 601x401
shoulder_definition: saved native sections; 0.25 <= abs(along_mm) <= 1.0; area-weighted section-node diagnostics
gate_scope: every inferred case must improve; oracle cases must not materially deteriorate; all six cases, fixed tolerances
quadrature: linearly interpolate individually thresholded endpoints; GL2 and GL4; no unseen snapshot assumption validation

units.HeatFluxZ: K/m per supplied derivative export; no independent HDF unit confirmation
units.gamma: empirical; m/s if stated coordinate/time units hold
